d:
CM Hemant Soren Speech :jharkhand vidhanasbha ke 26ven sthapna divas samaroh ka aayojan kiya gaya. is khas mauke par mukhyamantri hemant soren ne samaroh ko sanbodhit kiya. apne sanbodhan men unhonne vidhanasbha ke saphar aur jharkhand se jure muddon par apni bat rakhi.
Dekhie, vidhanasbha sthapna divas samaroh se CM hemant soren ka pura sanbodhna.
